primary_way_to_act.rule: Evidence precedes mutation. The model does not authorize itself.

rules: Repeated copies, mirrors, syndications, or summaries from one origin count as one source.
Search-result absence is not proof of absence.
Disagreement becomes a finding and blocks a seal when unresolved.

seal.checking_semantics: Verification process active; not proof of success.
seal.sealed_semantics: Defined verification gate passed for the declared scope only.

seal_evidence_record.scope_law: A seal proves the verification procedure passed for its declared scope; it does not prove more than the evidence supports.

last_web_seal.subject: Sublime Text 4 editor settings for deterministic Avalhla 100C/80C geometry

counter.source: Sublime Text Forum - Interaction between wrap_width_style and draw_centered

limitations: wrap_width is inert while word_wrap=false; it remains part of the declared 80-column geometry contract.
Visual glyph width can depend on font and viewport; the numeric ruler contract remains explicit.
last_web_seal.conclusion_basis: The four web checks agree that the selected settings are valid Sublime Text settings and that draw_centered=false is the deterministic choice for Avalhla's explicit 100C canvas and 80C core.

lanes.WEB_4X: Independent web verification only; sealed separately.
lanes.REPO_4X: Repository structure and implementation checks only; never substituted for web evidence.

latest_repo_cross_check.runtime_finding: Remote main still uses dynamic AVA_ROOT/AVA_MEMORY_DIR ownership; the hardened canonical runtime exists only in the user's local worktree and is not yet remote-confirmed.
latest_repo_cross_check.conclusion: Design law and remote Co-Build are aligned, but executable implementation is not globally complete; Phase 02 remains the active coding gate.

editor.change_law: No silent Sublime changes. AI may detect, explain, or propose. Dawa must be told before settings change.

distinctions.PROTECTED: semantic Avalhla state requiring deliberate handling

phasing.next_code_target: Make the public safety self-test contract real and keep test isolation compatible with canonical runtime ownership.

phases.name: FORENSIC_FREEZE
phases.goal: Establish exact state and resolve contradictions.
phases.exit: Real state inventory and contradictions recorded.

phases.name: RUNTIME_CANON
phases.goal: One canonical root and memory ownership.
phases.exit: Runtime cannot be redirected by inherited duplicate-path state.

phases.name: SAFETY_HEART
phases.goal: Central trusted read/write/append boundary and real self-test contract.
phases.exit: Positive and negative safety tests pass; test isolation is proven without weakening canonical ownership.

phases.name: MEMORY_WRITE_HEART
phases.goal: Migrate direct memory writers to the central safety boundary one writer class at a time.
phases.exit: Persistent memory writers are centrally gated and behavior-preserving.

phases.name: MEMORY_READ_HEART
phases.goal: Route context reads through lib_context -> lib_safety.
phases.exit: Memory/context readers fail closed on forbidden paths and unsafe symlinks.

phases.name: MEMORY_SEMANTICS
phases.goal: Preserve Reality, Memory, Reflection, Weave, Dream, Imagine, Record, and Dawa distinctions.
phases.exit: No layer silently becomes another layer's authority.

phases.name: AVA_RECORD
phases.goal: Prove record schema, provenance, trust, integrity, self-test, callers, and storage.
phases.exit: Record system has real callers/storage and verifier semantics are evidenced.

phases.name: MODEL_AUTHORITY_WALL
phases.goal: Enforce model visibility without model self-authorization.
phases.exit: Model can observe outputs/context but cannot authorize consequential actions.

phases.name: BOARD_DOORS
phases.goal: Keep board as map and doors as commands without dashboard drift.
phases.exit: Human-facing board remains small, present, and choice-preserving.

phases.name: ADVERSARIAL_VERIFY
phases.goal: Attack paths, writes, symlinks, records, authority, stale paths, and remote/local divergence.
phases.exit: Negative-path evidence is recorded and unresolved edges are explicit.

phases.name: GIT_CHECKPOINT
phases.goal: Freeze a verified state and reconcile local/remote.
phases.exit: VERIFY -> DIFF -> REVIEW -> COMMIT -> PUSH -> REMOTE_CONFIRM all pass.

phasing.transition_law: A phase advances only on its exit evidence. A failed gate holds the phase; a meaningful regression reopens the affected phase.
